beats.text: In Japan, 30% of all residents are aged 65 or older.
Dark blue is lowest, grey-gold is middle, and bright yellow is highest. We have data for 208 countries and territories.
Japan is the world's highest at 30%, while Qatar is the world's lowest at 2%.
The USA sits at 18%, while India is currently at 7%.
This measures the percentage of the total population aged 65 and above, counting all residents regardless of legal status or citizenship.
